title: Patch Notes · November 16, 2026
body:
Added
• New website at brindlewood.net with 58 guides, a page for each Kingdom, rules, privacy and terms, and a contact form (appeals included)
• Live "players adventuring" count on the website
• Weekly Most Active Player reward: 50 coins and a cosmetic crate key
• /bug and /suggestion now go straight to staff
• /newplayers report so staff can see where new players drop off
• Big moderation actions now need a second staff approval
• Nightly encrypted off-site backups for the bot
Changed
• Bedrock join steps clarified: add the friend account EuphoriaHQ7845, no IP needed
• Vote links updated, and the minecraftservers.org listing now shows the correct IP, Kingdoms and our website
• Automod now checks edited messages too
• Suggestions are now reviewed by staff instead of public voting
• Staff guides rebuilt as a few short pages
Fixed
• Ticket confirm buttons not replying
• Applications getting stuck
• Wrong version and Bedrock address on our server listings
• Playtime tracking now ignores bad data
Removed
• Old New Players and Roles panels
• Public suggestion voting
• The first set of 18 staff guides (replaced, see Changed)
Balance
• No balance changes this patch
